    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ML.NET 快速入门与实践教程：开源机器学习框架</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u5faea7d3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">千淘万漉虽辛苦，吹尽狂沙始到金。嗨，大家好！我是码农刚子。今天和大家聊一聊ML.NET 如何快速入门。</span></p>
<p id="u8e970868" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> 是微软为 .NET 开发者量身打造的机器学习框架，让你无需离开熟悉的 C# 环境，就能将智能功能集成到应用中。本文将从一个简单的成绩预测案例入手，逐步带你掌握数据加载、模型训练、评估和预测的全流程，后面有时间还会介绍能大幅提升效率的 Model Builder 可视化工具。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202603/1466017-20260302105403815-1164554261.png" alt="0b5ede506400ebce352c53be3aea0a34" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="2b12bd87"><span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">简介与环境搭建</span></span></h2>
<h3 id="08dc39d1"><span class="ne-text">什么是<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text">？</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="uc7d24644" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">是一个免费的、开源的、跨平台的机器学习框架，专为 .NET 开发者设计<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。它允许你在 .NET 应用程序（C# 或 F#）中构建、训练和部署自定义机器学习模型，而无需具备深厚的 Python 或 R 语言机器学习专业知识<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。无论是 .NET Core、.NET 5/8 还是 .NET Framework，<span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">都能完美支持<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="e8d8ae48"><span class="ne-text">安装<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span></span></span></h3>
<p id="u70410c35" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在你开始编码之前，需要先安装 <span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> NuGet 包。你可以通过 Visual Studio 的 NuGet 包管理器，或使用 .NET CLI 命令行工具来安装：</span></span></p>
<p id="u660b126e" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">dotnet add package Microsoft.ML</span></code></p>
<p id="uff4a9a41" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">除了核心库，根据你的任务场景，可能还需要其他包，比如用于数据操作的 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"> 或包含特定算法的 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"> 。</span></code></span></code></span></p>
<h2 id="6606deff"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">核心概念：理解<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">的工作流程</span></span></span></span></code></code></h2>
<p id="u87d98962" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">使用<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">构建机器学习模型遵循一个标准化的流程，理解这些核心概念是入门的关键<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></code></code></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ub32e4556" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">MLContext</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：一切操作的起点。它像一个“上下文”或“工厂”，提供了数据加载、模型训练、模型评估等所有 API 的入口<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。你可以把它想象成<span class="ne-text"> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">DbContext</span></code><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">之于 EF Core。</span></span></span></span></span></span></code></code></li>
<li id="u1292ec6f" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">IDataView</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：<span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">的核心数据抽象。它不是一个简单的内存集合，而是一个灵活、高效的表格数据表示形式，用于数据加载、转换和训练。你可以从 CSV、SQL 数据库或内存集合中创建它<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></span></code></code></li>
<li id="uf09ed3c8" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">数据处理管道</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：在训练模型之前，原始数据通常需要进行清洗、转换和特征工程。<span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">允许你将一系列的数据转换操作（如连接特征、处理缺失值、文本向量化）组合成一个管道<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></span></code></code></li>
<li id="uaa3ed148" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">训练器 (Trainer)</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：即机器学习算法。<span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">内置了丰富的训练器，用于解决回归、分类、聚类、异常检测等不同任务<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></span></code></code></li>
<li id="u6446fa82" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">模型 (ITransformer)</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：数据管道和训练器组合在一起，对数据“拟合”后生成的产物。这个模型可以被保存、加载，并用于对新数据进行预测<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></code></code></li>
<li id="ue1f72a81" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">预测引擎 (PredictionEngine)</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：模型训练好后，你需要使用<span class="ne-text"> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">CreatePredictionEngine</span></code><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">创建一个预测引擎，它接收单个输入数据对象，并输出预测结果<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></code></code></li>
</ul>
<p id="ua483e976" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">下图清晰地展示了从数据到最终预测的完整流程：</span></code></code></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202603/1466017-20260302105453022-1742086710.png" alt="a496b76ba6a21941c15f3cd106d39c39" loading="lazy"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u5c63549d" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">准备数据源（CSV, txt, 数据库等）</span></code></code></li>
<li id="ub85e3c6a" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">MLContext.Create() 加载数据至 IDataView</span></code></code></li>
<li id="ue40868c6" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">定义数据处理管道（特征提取， 连接， 转换等）</span></code></code></li>
<li id="u1302cac5" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">追加训练器（如 Sdca 回归）</span></code></code></li>
<li id="u8e259b68" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">在训练数据上调用 Fit 方法</span></code></code></li>
<li id="ue814e151" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">得到训练完成的模型（ITransformer）</span></code></code></li>
<li id="u7a14b1ce" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">保存模型为：Model.zip</span></code></code></li>
<li id="uae2840d4" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">创建 PredictionEngine 用于单次预测</span></code></code></li>
<li id="u67ca17d3" data-lake-index-type="0"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">输入新数据，然后输出预测结果</span></code></code></li>
</ol>
<h2 id="78317b9a"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">实践案例：学生考试成绩预测（回归）</span></code></code></h2>
<p id="uf259d73f" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">让我们通过一个最简单的例子——根据学习时长预测考试成绩，来动手实践<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">的整个工作流。这是经典的<strong><span class="ne-text">回归</span></strong><span class="ne-text">任务，即预测一个连续的数值<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></code></p>
<h3 id="f9780bbc"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">1. 准备数据</span></code></code></h3>
<p id="u5a55d571" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">首先，创建一个名为 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">data.csv</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 的文件，内容如下：</span></span></code></code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">StudyHours,Score
1,50
2,60
3,65
4,70
5,75</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="0a410dbf"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">2. 定义数据类</span></code></code></h3>
<p id="u4d105498" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">在你的 C# 项目中，定义两个类来映射数据和预测结果 。</span></code></code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.ML.Data;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于加载输入数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StudentData
{
    [LoadColumn(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 指定在数据文件中的列索引</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> StudyHours { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    [LoadColumn(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> Score { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这是标签（Label），即我们要预测的值</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于存储预测结果</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StudentPrediction
{
    [ColumnName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 指定输出列的名称，需与模型输出的列名一致</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> PredictedScore { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 id="2454bac4"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">3. 构建、训练并评估模型</span></code></code></h3>
<p id="u493a7306" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">现在，在 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Program.cs</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 中编写核心逻辑 。</span></span></code></code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.ML;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 初始化 MLContext</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> mlContext = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> MLContext(seed: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置随机种子以确保结果可重现

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 加载数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> dataPath = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">data.csv</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> data = mlContext.Data.LoadFromTextFile&lt;StudentData&gt;(dataPath, separatorChar: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, hasHeader: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 分割数据集为训练集和测试集</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> trainTestSplit = mlContext.Data.TrainTestSplit(data, testFraction: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> trainData = trainTestSplit.TrainSet; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于训练的数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> testData = trainTestSplit.TestSet;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用于评估的数据

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 构建数据处理和训练管道
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">    - Concatenate: 将所有特征列（这里是 StudyHours）合并到一个名为 "Features" 的列中，这是 ML.NET 的默认输入列名
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">    - Append: 追加一个回归训练器（SDCA 算法）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> pipeline = mlContext.Transforms.Concatenate(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Features</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">StudyHours</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> })
    .Append(mlContext.Regression.Trainers.Sdca(labelColumnName: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, maximumNumberOfIterations: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 在训练集上训练模型</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> model =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pipeline.Fit(trainData);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 在测试集上评估模型性能</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> predictions =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.Transform(testData);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> metrics = mlContext.Regression.Evaluate(predictions, labelColumnName: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, scoreColumnName: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 7. 输出评估指标</span>
Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模型评估指标：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  R^2: {metrics.RSquared:F2}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 决定系数，越接近1越好</span>
Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  平均绝对误差: {metrics.MeanAbsoluteError:F2}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">  均方根误差: {metrics.RootMeanSquaredError:F2}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 8. 使用模型进行单次预测</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> predictionEngine = mlContext.Model.CreatePredictionEngine&lt;StudentData, StudentPrediction&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(model);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> newStudent = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> StudentData { StudyHours = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> predictedScore =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> predictionEngine.Predict(newStudent);

Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n预测结果：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">如果学习 {newStudent.StudyHours} 小时，预测成绩为 {predictedScore.PredictedScore:F2}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="a2f7994b"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">4. 运行与结果</span></code></code></h3>
<p id="u6cd3f2c4" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">运行你的应用程序，你将看到类似下面的输出：</span></code></code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">模型评估指标：
  R^2: 0.92
  平均绝对误差: 1.25
  均方根误差: 1.58

预测结果：
如果学习 6 小时，预测成绩为 80.45</pre>
</div>
<p id="u8d329639" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">恭喜！你已经成功构建并训练了你的第一个 <span class="ne-text">ML.NET</span><span class="ne-text"> 模型。</span></span></code></code></p>
<p id="u21a66306" class="ne-p"><code class="ne-code"><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">还有类似的模型可以自己去尝试练习：房价预测，和以上示例相同逻辑，代码非常的简单。</span></code></code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 定义数据模型：输入特征（用来预测的变量）和输出标签（要预测的结果）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 房价的影响因素：面积、卧室数量、浴室数量</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.ML;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.ML.Data;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HouseData
{
    [LoadColumn(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对应数据文件的第1列（面积）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> Size { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    [LoadColumn(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对应数据文件的第2列（卧室数量）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> Bedrooms { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    [LoadColumn(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对应数据文件的第3列（浴室数量）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> Bathrooms { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    [LoadColumn(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 对应数据文件的第4列（房价，标签）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> Price { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 定义预测结果模型：只包含要预测的标签</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HousePricePrediction
{
    [ColumnName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)] <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Score是ML.NET默认的预测结果列名</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> PredictedPrice { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Program
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> Main(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] args)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 创建ML.NET环境（类似数据库连接，是所有操作的基础）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> mlContext = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MLContext();

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 准备训练数据（实际项目中可以从Excel、数据库读取，这里用模拟数据）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> trainingData = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;HouseData&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HouseData { Size = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1400</span>, Bedrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, Bathrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, Price = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">250000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HouseData { Size = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1600</span>, Bedrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>, Bathrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.5f</span>, Price = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">300000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HouseData { Size = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1200</span>, Bedrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, Bathrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.5f</span>, Price = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HouseData { Size = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1800</span>, Bedrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>, Bathrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, Price = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">350000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HouseData { Size = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2000</span>, Bedrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>, Bathrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3.5f</span>, Price = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">400000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 实际训练需要更多数据，这里只是示例</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 将数据转换成ML.NET能处理的IDataView</span>
        IDataView dataView =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mlContext.Data.LoadFromEnumerable(trainingData);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 定义训练管道：数据处理→特征工程→模型算法</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> pipeline = mlContext.Transforms.Concatenate(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Features</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, nameof(HouseData.Size), nameof(HouseData.Bedrooms), nameof(HouseData.Bathrooms))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 特征归一化：让不同量级的特征（比如面积1000+，卧室数2-5）统一范围，提高模型精度</span>
            .Append(mlContext.Transforms.NormalizeMinMax(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Features</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 选择回归算法（房价预测是连续值，用回归），这里用SDCA算法（ML.NET推荐的高效算法）</span>
            .Append(mlContext.Regression.Trainers.Sdca(labelColumnName: nameof(HouseData.Price), featureColumnName: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Features</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 7. 训练模型（核心步骤，相当于让模型“学习”数据规律）</span>
        Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">开始训练模型...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> model =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pipeline.Fit(dataView);
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模型训练完成！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 8. 用训练好的模型做预测（测试数据：面积1500，3卧室，2浴室）</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> predictionEngine = mlContext.Model.CreatePredictionEngine&lt;HouseData, HousePricePrediction&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(model);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> testHouse = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HouseData { Size = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1500</span>, Bedrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, Bathrooms = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> prediction =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> predictionEngine.Predict(testHouse);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 9. 输出预测结果</span>
        Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">预测房价：{prediction.PredictedPrice:C}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202603/1466017-20260302105529441-1203104981.png" alt="e6cc4b063066e4bb2789d25e8e0e02d9" loading="lazy"></p>
